note: Every street and park tree the game shows, one row per tree: id (inv:<borough>-<EMP_NO> from the city inventory, osm:<node> for an OSM tree the inventory lacks), x_cm, y_cm, z_cm (ground under the trunk: the pit soil, a sidewalk, lawn or bare ground), species (the inventory's Latin name, or unknown), kind (a Trees manifest kind, from TREE_SPECIES and TREE_GENERA in plateau_replica.py, else by crown size), dbh_cm (trunk diameter at breast height; dbh_from says when it is estimated), height_cm (from the trunk, research-plateau.md 10.4), source (inventory or osm), placement (the inventory's Emplacement), pit (in a sidewalk or extension pit), yaw_deg (seeded); moved_cm and mapped_xy_cm when the tree moved into a sidewalk pit, extension (index into extensions), conifer (no conifer kind yet).
